title.narrative: IIGCC - Catalysing Investor Action on Deforestation

description.narrative:
IIGCC is a member organization that works with its members to address climate risk. The project “Catalysing Investor Action on Deforestation” will support investors to collectively engage their underlying assets (companies and banks) to eliminate deforestation, equip investors with the necessary tools and guidance to prioritise deforestation risk; and create avenues for investors to influence policymakers to create a more enabling regulatory environment to halt deforestation. The project’s main objectives are: - Impact: Deforestation-free financial markets established that mitigate climate risks, nurture resilient ecosystems, and create a sustainable future. - Outcome 1: Companies and banks implement deforestation-free practices and supply chains as a result of enhanced investor engagement and stewardship - Outcome 2: Institutional investors prioritise halting deforestation and scaling deforestation-free supply chains, and integrate deforestation into investment strategies and policies - Outcome 3: Regulatory environment supports deforestation-free company practices and supply chains The project activities contribute to forest protection in ODA countries through reducing pressure on deforestation from global markets. The project will influence the financial institutions to change their investments from companies in the commodity supply chains that drive deforestation towards those who do not.
Strengthening of biodiversity, climate mitigation and environment are main objectives of the project at impact level. Influencing financial market actors to divest from deforestation-driving commodity supply chains and redirect investments to deforestation-free supply chains will contribute to reducing deforestation and thereby protect biodiversity and ecosystems in the standing tropical forests, reduce CO2-emissions and protect carbon sinks in the standing tropical forest and and produce an improvement in the physical and biological environment of tropical forest
